overview.elements: › **Clickable elements** are buttons and dropdowns that members can click in your message. Create them with the button below, then pick them in the dropdown to edit them.
overview.actions: › Every element runs **actions** when it is clicked - for example handing out roles, sending a message or opening a form. You set them up once you have selected an element.

link.label: Link button
link.description: › Opens a web page or Discord URL when clicked.

button.label: Button
button.description: › Standard button with all possible actions.

select_strings.label: Dropdown
select_strings.description: › Standard dropdown with actions per item.

select_roles.label: Role dropdown
select_roles.description: › Shows the user a list of roles.

kind_view.title: ⚡ ~ Create clickable element
kind_view.description: › Choose in the lower dropdown which kind of supported clickable element you want to create. Afterwards you can set the actions that run on a click.

role.description: › Choose in the first lower dropdown what should happen to the user with the roles you selected. In the dropdown below it you can then pick the corresponding roles.

message.title: 💬 ~ Message action
message.description: › Here you can set a message that is sent under specific rules and what content it has.
message.no_channel: none yet - pick it in the dropdown below
message.default_text:
Hello, {{user}} 👋 - Welcome to the coolest server **{{server}}**!
You are one of {{server.members}} members and opened the menu on {{date}} at {{time}} in {{channel}}.

variables.title: Supported variables
variables.user_joined: day the person joined the server
variables.server_members: number of members of the server
variables.answer: answer to question 1 - `answer.2` for question 2 and so on

actions.title: ⚙️ ~ Actions
actions.description: › Choose what happens when the element is clicked. The actions run in the order they are shown in the lower dropdown menu.
actions.description_form:
› Choose what happens when the form is submitted - in the order it is listed in the dropdown.

› The answers of the form are available through the variables `{{answers}}` (all) and `{{answer.1}}` to `{{answer.5}}`.

conditions.title: 🔒 ~ Restrictions
conditions.description: › You can set restrictions to control who may click this element to trigger an action. Everyone else will get an error message telling them which restriction has to be met.

description.strings: › Here you can set the choices of the dropdown. Every option you create has its own action and restrictions that you can set.
description.roles: › Here you can pick the roles of the dropdown. This works like a "toggle" - roles are handed out or, when chosen again (or if the user already has them), removed.

questions.title: ❓ ~ Questions of {name}
questions.description: › Manage the questions of your super cool form here - they are asked in the order they are arranged in the lower dropdown.

placement.title: 📍 ~ Place element {name}
placement.description: › Choose in the lower dropdown where the selected element goes in your message.
placement.confirm: › There is no clickable element in your message yet. Are you sure you want to place the element in the message?
